These compounds are all known to interact with Retinoic acid receptor alpha, indicating a potential chain of molecular interactions that could lead to the activation or modulation of this receptor. The evidence supports a biologically plausible mechanism, but further experimental validation is required to confirm the direct interaction between Simtuzumab and Retinoic acid receptor alpha.
